name: 80924 · Colorado Spgs, CO
findings: ZIP 80924 (Colorado Spgs) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80924 (Colorado Spgs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80924 (Colorado Spgs) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
